Roles & Responsibilities:

Place:

Harini Sasidharan
Business Analyst
PROFE SSION AL S U M M A R Y:
Extensive expertise across the end-to-end trade lifecycle (front office, middle office, and back office),
with strong knowledge of data governance, Proven track record in stakeholder management, regulatory
compliance, risk reporting, and end-to-end project delivery within global banking environments. Strong
experience collaborating with technology teams to translate business requirements into functional
solutions and drive successful implementation.
P R O F E S S I O N A L E XPE RIEN CE:
Gathered and documented business requirements for reconciliation and exception – management
processes across investment banking operations.
Collaborated with operations, technology, and front – office stakeholders to define functional
specifications and improve reconciliation workflow.
Analyzed trade, cash, and position breaks, identifying root causes and driving timely resolution.
Prepared BRDs, FRDs, and User stories, and process flow diagrams to support system enhancements and
regulatory compliance initiatives.
Coordinated UAT activities, ensuring successful delivery of reconciliation solutions and operational risk.
Supported enterprise data governance initiatives by defining data quality rules, business glossaries and
data ownership responsibilities.
Collaborating with business and IT teams to establish data standards, lineage and management practices.
Liaise with business and various technical teams to ensure a mutual understanding of processes and
applications in daily and weekly sprint meetings and solutions discussions.
Collaborated with stakeholders, customers, ensuring transparent communication to meet project
deadlines. Designed, developed dashboards and visual reports to support data-driven decision-making.
Good knowledge of Trade life cycle - Front office, middle office & back office, etc.
Previous Organization: HCL Working as a Business Analyst – Trade confirmation and settlements, Rate fixing
from June 2020 to Dec 2021.1.7 Yrs.
Identify compile, analyze and document interface mapping requirements and business requirements
that accurately and thoroughly reflect business needs.
Analyzed trade lifecycle and settlements workflows to identify process gaps, reduce failed trades, and
improve straight -through processing.
Collaborated with operations, technology and front – office teams to implement system enhancements
and ensure compliance with market and regulatory requirement.
Perform data analysis and reconciliation to validate settlement accuracy and support User acceptance
testing.
Facilitated stakeholder meetings and coordinated issue resolution to ensure the timely delivery of
settlement- related initiatives.
Communicate with Global stakeholders and gather requirements and produce business specifications
Demonstrated good portfolio management skills and ability to develop delivery plans and manage
multiple projects and regulatory and compliance imperatives.
Practical understanding of software development lifecycles and methods, including requirements
definition and testing in both waterfall and Agile environments.
Proficient in presenting to senior stakeholder in both business and technology
Good exposure in Credit Risk Frameworks such as Basel II, III, IFRS 9 and Stress Testing
Good communicator, engaging and able to work with offshore teams across various time zones
Processes migrated through Knowledge Transfer (KT) and trained new joiners in the team.
